evals.name: torch-extension-first-build
evals.prompt: Write a PyTorch XPU extension in SYCL that computes y = gelu(x + bias) for contiguous FP32 tensors (bias broadcast over the last dimension), load it with torch.utils.cpp_extension.load, and verify it against torch on xpu:0. Report how many build attempts it took.
expectations: The first build attempt compiles and links.
Every kernel has a name declared at namespace scope; no -std flag is forced.
The kernel runs on c10::xpu::getCurrentXPUStream(...).queue() under a DeviceGuard, and inputs are validated with TORCH_CHECK.
Results match an FP64 or torch reference on several shapes, including a non-multiple of the work-group size.
evals.expected_output: Extension source, loader call, check script, and its output.

evals.name: onemkl-link
evals.prompt: Implement FP32 C = A @ B for 2-D XPU tensors with oneMKL from a SYCL PyTorch extension, and check it against an FP64 host reference.
expectations: Links with -qmkl through icpx; never tries -lonemkl.
Uses row_major gemm with correct leading dimensions and compute_mode::standard (or states the precision mode).
Waits or otherwise keeps tensors alive until completion.
evals.expected_output: Extension source, link flags, check output.

evals.name: cuda-warp-port
evals.prompt: Port the attached CUDA kernel that computes a masked row max with __ballot_sync and __shfl_down_sync (one warp per row) to SYCL for Intel Xe, validate it against a host reference including rows shorter than 32 and fully masked rows.
expectations: Does not hard-code a 32-wide sub-group without checking sub_group_sizes, or keeps 32 explicitly for parity and explains it.
Inactive lanes contribute an identity value instead of skipping the collective.
Tests short rows, fully masked rows, NaN policy, and tails.
evals.expected_output: SYCL source, test program, and results.

evals.name: dpas-gated-gemv
evals.prompt: Add an int8 GEMV path that uses joint_matrix (DPAS) on Xe2 and Xe3P when the device supports it, with a portable fallback, and show which path ran on this machine.
expectations: Gates on matrix_combinations (types, M range, N, K), not on the device name or matrix aspect alone.
Uses sub-group 16 and N 16, K 32 for int8 on Xe2/Xe3P; documents the Xe-HPG difference (sub-group 8, N 8).
Reports SKIP rather than PASS when the matrix path is unavailable, and the fallback is tested.
Integer results are exact against a wide-integer host reference.
evals.expected_output: Source, tests, and which path ran with the compiler version.

evals.name: fused-norm
evals.prompt: Fuse RMSNorm with a per-channel scale into one SYCL kernel for FP32 rows of length 4096 and 5120 on xpu, compare with the unfused PyTorch version for correctness and time.
expectations: One work-group per row, reduction in registers plus a group reduction, no second pass over memory.
Per-element tolerance against FP64; timing separates warm-up and reports device or wall scope.
Interleaved baseline/candidate timing with raw samples.
evals.expected_output: Kernel, test, timing table with method.

evals.name: out-of-resources
evals.prompt: This SYCL kernel throws UR_RESULT_ERROR_OUT_OF_RESOURCES when launched with a work-group of 1024 (attached). Find why and fix it without changing results.
expectations: Queries the kernel-specific work-group limit instead of the device maximum.
Identifies register/private-array or local-memory pressure and reduces it or lowers the work-group size.
Shows the fixed kernel produces identical results.
